about: Sign-offs for the release gate (edakit gate). Each one counts only for the hash of its scope: 'circuit' = state_sha256 (graph, parts database, simulation config), 'layout' = layout_sha256 (layout files, artwork, footprint geometry), 'fab' = fab_sha256 (what the manufacturer builds from a gate run: Gerber layers, drill hits, BOM and CPL rows). When something there changes, it no longer counts – copy the new hash from the protocol header after the check was repeated. phase: 'export' blocks the release, 'order' and 'acceptance' come after the export. An accepted warning with scope 'decision' counts regardless of the hash and refers to a numbered decision in the docs. Parts are signed in their parts entry (field 'verified').

manual.text: Critical parts (U1 T-Display pinout and the project-library footprint, C1 polarity, the 0805 LEDs' polarity, J1 servo pinout) checked a second time independently against datasheet and footprint – e.g. by the agent electrical-reviewer
manual.note: M-1: OK for state 6ca3b2e3…; requirements met: R-7, R-12, R-34. Second check on 2026-11-01 (edakit bc44fa7). U1's pins 1–24 match LILYGO's T-Display V1.1 pin map and its KiCad footprint (rows 22.860 mm, pin 1 = 5V and 13 = 3V3 at the USB end); footprint_data (D-30): 2 × 12 pads at 2.54 mm, x = ±11.43 mm, square pads 1/13 at the USB end, 1.7 mm pads with 1.1 mm holes, agreeing with the dump to 0.002 mm. main.cpp = locks.pins: LEDs IO27/26/25/33/32, servo IO13, start IO38, reset IO37. IO2/IO12/IO15 (U1.19/16/18) not connected, IO0 not on the header. R-7: the 5V pin is VBUS through D2 1N5819 (LILYGO ESP32-TFT(6-26)), no fuse; stalled it carries 1.055 A for at most 5.8 s, about 0.6 W, 6 % above its 1 A rating (surge 9–25 A): no damage in one bell phase. KT-0805 LEDs and C3359 as on smd. Notes: inrush; repeated ring with a jam heats the 1N5819 (a firmware cooldown would help); the T-Display's row spacing is measured before ordering (TODO).

manual.text: Layout reviewed independently (manufacturability; mechanics: USB at the edge; operation of the buttons; looks of the LED row) on the manufacturing files of a gate run – e.g. by the agent pcb-reviewer
manual.note: M-5: OK for fab hash 4d647542… (gate run 20261101-130240, edakit 8c6652c). Against the reviewed fe891ad5… (20261101-004304), edakit fab diff shows the GND stitch of D-41, one [[pours]] entry per side: top +14.6 mm² in three GND islands at S1 and R7 (6.3 mm² between S1's lower pads, 5.3 mm² at x 52.4–56.6, y 10.0–11.5, 3.0 mm² at x 52.7–55.1, y 6.9–9.2) with vias at (57.55, 7.72), (54.29, 10.77), (54.28, 8.48); bottom +19.5 mm² at the T-Display's lower pin row (x 37.6–47.2, y 15.6–20.1) with a via at (43.20, 18.69) under U1; vias Ø0.305/0.61 mm, ring 0.152 mm, tented (mask layers equal); otherwise refill noise below 0.01 mm²; silk, mask, paste, outline, NPTH, BOM, CPL and order.json equal (EasyEDA Pro 3.2.209). From the Gerber files: islands 0.256 mm from foreign copper, no neck under 0.3 mm, no corner under 60°, nothing loose; the bottom via 1.32 mm from the joints U1.11/U1.12, the top vias ≥ 1.0 mm from S1's pads; copper top 86.9 → 87.3 %, bottom 90.4 → 90.8 %, bare only the keeps and a 3.6 mm² track gap on the bottom at (46.7, 17.8) where no pour fits. Order unchanged: JLCPCB, 2 layers, 1.6 mm, green/white, LeadFree HASL, Remove Mark, Economic PCBA top with the 2 × Ø1.152 mm tooling holes at (3.5, 45)/(81.5, 20), mask open and copper-free. Stage L warnings only D-21 (C1, S1, S2). Notes: seven tented vias now within 8 mm around START (three new) – looks only; hand_solder_keep_mm 0.5 and [looks] for the next layout change.

manual.text: Regulatory review: circuit and parts against EU law for the stated purpose (RoHS, REACH, radio, batteries, product safety) – the agent regulatory-reviewer in its own session; support, not legal advice: no claim to correctness, nothing legally guaranteed
manual.note: M-6: OK for state 1beca6c8… (electrical) and purpose private; requirements met: R-10, R-33. Wi-Fi only on channels 1–13 (2412–2472 MHz): the firmware sets country DE with 802.11d off after every mode change and turns the radio off if that fails; the module's own antenna at default power, at most 20.5 dBm − 4.32 dBi ≈ 16.2 dBm e.i.r.p. against 20 dBm; no Bluetooth; powered only through the T-Display's USB-C, no cell at the module's battery input, no mains. D-36 settles the CE-marking condition of Austria's FMaG 2016 § 24: the radio equipment in service is the unmodified, CE-marked T-Display (the owner checks the mark on arrival, else Wi-Fi stays off). Notes: the ground copper under the antenna end is not checked (3.8 dB margin); erase the home Wi-Fi password before the module leaves the house; RoHS, REACH, WEEE and a CE marking of the bell itself do not apply to own use. Support, not legal advice: no claim to correctness, nothing legally guaranteed.

manual.text: At JLCPCB after the upload: assembly preview (LEDs, C1, J1, buttons, resistors), BOM without missing parts, price

Acceptance of every delivered board: visual check, T-Display plugged in, current through USB, every LED, both buttons, the servo swings, the display shows the countdown; Wi-Fi: the setup hotspot Glocke-XXXX on channels 1–13 with WPA2, the page at glocke.local, no Bluetooth device of the bell; the module marked T-DISPLAY V1.1
